name: Morrigan
source:
The goddess of war in Celtic mythology. She is also known as the “Great Queen” and the “Goddess of Death.

She is revered by her peers as a goddess who possesses powerful magical powers and leads them to victory in battle. Noble and proud, her beautiful and bewitching body have captivated tens of thousands of men.

It is said that she has captivated tens of thousands of men, but in reality she is a virgin who is getting older.

Cú Chulainn is young, beautiful, and strong, and she falls in love with him. She is captured and becomes an outlet for his desires.
